sub: What you have sold and what reaches your bank.

cobros.conectarTitulo: Connect your payouts to start selling
cobros.conectarTexto: Without payouts connected nobody can pay you. We will ask for your details and your account number.
cobros.listos: Payouts connected: the money from each sale reaches your bank.
cobros.propios: You get paid with your own payment account.

resumen.enCaminoNota: Arrives in the next few days

vacio.titulo: Your sales will show up here
vacio.texto: Every time someone buys, it shows up here with what reaches your bank and when.
vacio.botonCompartir: Share your link to get the first one

enlace.notaAntes: It switches on when you publish from Start here.
enlace.precioInvalido: Write a price greater than zero.
enlace.precioError: Could not change the price. Try again.
enlace.comision: Didacta keeps {percent}% of each sale. You see it broken down on each payment.
enlace.notaNoComprable: Connect your payouts so people can buy. Until then the link cannot be used to sell.

referidos.texto: Each student has their own link. When someone joins through it and pays, the person who invited them gets a % of what they pay.
referidos.soloMembresia: It works with a membership: once you sell one, each student gets a link and earns a % of every payment from the people they bring. A one-off course does not earn a commission.
referidos.porcentaje: What the person who invites gets (%)
referidos.ventasVacio: None yet. When someone pays through a student's link, you will see it here.
referidos.ventasResumen: {n, plural, one {# payment brought} other {# payments brought}} by your students

propias.texto: Payments for your course or membership collected with your own payment account.
propias.vacio: This is where you will see how many sales you have. Share your sales link to get the first one.
